rows.name: Brief is verbatim
rows.proves: Every sentence in the readiness register is a literal substring of the captured brief.
rows.does_not_prove: That the brief is complete — only that nothing was reworded.

rows.name: Readiness rows are complete
rows.proves: Every row names a gate that exists in a published gate register and carries a clearing number.
rows.does_not_prove: That the clearing number is achievable — it is a target, not a forecast.

rows.name: Site links resolve
rows.proves: Every internal link in the served tree resolves, and every data-table row carries an official source link.
rows.does_not_prove: That the linked page still exists — a link to a live official page is checked at build time only.

rows.name: Deck contract
rows.proves: Every deck table row has a source cell, no placeholder leaked, navigation is complete.
rows.does_not_prove: That the values are right — only that each one is attributed.

rows.name: Published cells match the official page
rows.proves: Every published Week 10 cell equals an independent transcription of the official page.
rows.does_not_prove: That the official page has not changed since the transcription date.

rows.name: Injury re-capture diff
rows.proves: Row-by-row comparison of the current official report against the published table.
rows.does_not_prove: That either capture is the final word — the report changes daily.

rows.name: Standings arithmetic
rows.proves: W+L+T = games played, and PF/PA reconcile, for every club row.
rows.does_not_prove: That the standings are current — only that they are internally consistent.

rows.name: Results feed reconciliation
rows.proves: The mirror's game results reproduce the league's own standings for the 2026 season.
rows.does_not_prove: That the mirror is complete — the reconcile covers 137 games.

rows.name: Origination step order
rows.proves: Side is step 1, total step 2, moneyline step 3 on every originated row.
rows.does_not_prove: That the order is optimal — only that it is the order published.

rows.name: Difference recomputation
rows.proves: Every published difference equals model minus market, recomputed from the row.
rows.does_not_prove: That the model number is good — that is what the RMSE comparison is for.

rows.name: Correlation sources
rows.proves: Every correlation pair comes from an official host, and n is present on every value.
rows.does_not_prove: That the correlation is causal — it is a measured association.

rows.name: Signal/staking separation
rows.proves: The leaderboard rank key provably excludes staking, ROI and equity fields.
rows.does_not_prove: That the signal is skilful — only that staking cannot influence the rank.

rows.name: Luck panel reproducibility
rows.proves: The published percentiles and intervals equal a fresh recomputation from the committed CSVs.
rows.does_not_prove: That the simulation is the only way to read the data — it is a null model.

rows.name: Venue transcription
rows.proves: Every Week 10 fixture has a stadium and location transcribed with its own game-centre URL.
rows.does_not_prove: That a venue will not change — it should not, but no check can prove that.

rows.name: Deployed tree crawl
rows.proves: The exact tree uploaded to Pages is assembled and crawled; every link in it resolves.
rows.does_not_prove: That the CDN serves the new tree immediately.

rows.name: Source-rule mutation test
rows.proves: The source rule actually fails when a source link is removed (a mutation test).
rows.does_not_prove: That every row's source is the right source — only that a missing one is caught.
